title: LinkedIn Post Writer
one_line: Write a LinkedIn post that sounds like the person and earns a reason to exist.
description: Write a LinkedIn post that sounds like the person and earns a reason to exist. Use when someone needs a post, wants to build a publishing cadence, has a result to share, or asks for content ideas for their profile.
paragraph: Most generated LinkedIn posts fail on the first line and on the reason for posting. This skill starts from something that actually happened, finds the first line that makes the second line necessary, and writes in the poster's own rhythm rather than in platform voice.
keywords: i have a result to share
requirements_summary: Needs no account, key or paid service: it works from the files, exports and answers you give it.
